reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 24.1 gives Customer a consent-free affiliate/M&A successor carve-out (notice only), § 24.2 restricts Vendor assignment, delegation and change-of-control transfer to Customer's prior written consent with a competitor bar, and § 24.4 expressly negates any Vendor termination, suspension, repricing or fee-acceleration right on Customer's change of control — all elements of the preferred position.

No redline or counterparty comment is expected for a compliant finding, and none was proposed; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs, so there is no directional or drafting error to correct.
Deterministic check confirming the Customer successor/affiliate carve-out passed, consistent with the rationale.

Minor, non-disqualifying nuance: § 24.2 permits Vendor assignment to a direct Customer competitor with our consent rather than an absolute bar, and the reasonableness qualifier is capability/financial-standing limited — this remains at or above the preferred position and does not warrant a deviation finding.
